name: VT-4 / Haider
armament: 125 mm smoothbore with autoloader (GP2 gun-launched ATGM)
protection: Modular composite with FY-4 ERA, soft-kill APS. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Angular wedge turret front covered with ERA, large rear bustle
Six road wheels per side, ERA-covered skirts
RWS on roof, laser warners on turret sides
Reports in 2026 of stalled inductions due to reliability and budget problems
